senses.zh: （不使用呼吸装备的) 自由潜水
senses.en: the sport or activity of diving without the aid of breathing equipment
examples: They noticed she was very good at holding her breath and suggested she try [[freediving]].

senses.en: (also championships) a competition to find which player, team, etc. is the best in a particular sport
examples: The sixth game of the World Chess [[Championship]] will be broadcast tonight on Channel 6.

senses.zh: 肤浅的；浅薄的；不深入的
senses.en: not studying or looking at sth. carefully and only seeing the most noticeable things
examples: Unfortunately I only had a very [[superficial]] knowledge of music.

senses.zh: 然而；但是；尽管如此；虽然如此
senses.en: (fml.) in spite of the fact that has just been mentioned
examples: The region was extremely beautiful. [[Nonetheless]], Gerard could not imagine spending the rest of his life there.

senses.zh: （活动或体育比赛的）观看者，观众
senses.en: sb. who is watching an event or a game
examples: The final baseball game which was held last Thursday attracted a crowd of over 50,000 [[spectators]].

senses.zh: （通常使用特种呼吸辅助装备的）潜水员
senses.en: sb. who swims or works under water, usu. with special equipment to help them breathe
examples: Twenty minutes later, a [[diver]] surfaced and handed a metal box to the elderly gentleman.

senses.en: hang or swing loosely, or make sth. do this
examples: We stood in the orchard (果园), where the apples were ripe and [[dangled]] just inches above our heads.

senses.zh: 使恐惧；使十分害怕；使惊吓
senses.en: make sb. feel extremely frightened
examples: He had imagined that going down in the caves late at night would [[terrify]] her, but instead she felt surprisingly calm.

senses.en: not covered by any clothes
examples: While she was walking around her house in [[bare]] feet, her mom just didn't seem to notice.

senses.en: one of a set of movements in swimming or rowing in which you move your arms or the oar forward and then back
examples: She walked into the water and began to swim with strong [[strokes]] to the middle of the lake.

senses.en: a sudden serious illness when a blood vessel in the brain bursts or is blocked, which can cause death or the loss of the ability to move or to speak clearly
examples: It is reported that air pollution could also restrict blood flow, causing [[strokes]] and heart attacks.

senses.en: make sth. less tight or firmly fixed; become less tight or firmly fixed
examples: He took a screwdriver (螺丝刀) from his pocket and began to [[loosen]] the screws on the bike.

senses.zh: （延缓张伞的）特技跳伞运动员
senses.en: sb. who jumps from a plane and falls for as long as they can before opening the parachute
examples: As a [[skydiver]] falls, he accelerates downward, gaining speed with each second.

senses.en: n. a particular position in which sb. stands, sits, etc., esp. in order to be painted, drawn or photographed
examples: Please ask the model to stay in that [[pose]] anywhere from 30 seconds to 1 minute.

senses.zh: 造成（威胁、问题等）；引起；产生
senses.en: vt.create a threat, problem, etc. that has to be dealt with
examples: Concerns about the danger [[posed]] by fireworks could lead to restrictions on their sale and use.

senses.en: disappear suddenly and / or in a way that you cannot explain
examples: Three boats [[vanished]] without a trace one day and have never been found.

senses.zh: 声呐（船上或潜艇上利用声波探测水下目标位置的仪器）

senses.en: (fml.) the process of going down
examples: The night turned cold and heavy rain began to fall during our [[descent]] from the mountain peak.

senses.en: vt. (AmE check) mark a test, list of questions, etc. with a tick, in order to show that sth. is correct, to choose sth., etc.
examples: She is used to [[ticking]] off all of the things that she has done before the end of the day.

senses.en: vi.(also ~ away) if a clock or watch ticks, it makes a short repeated sound
examples: The clock on the wall [[ticked]] away, its sound echoing through the otherwise silent room.

senses.zh: （尤因难以抉择或等待过久而）折磨人的
senses.en: (BrE agonising)1) very unpleasant to experience, esp. because of involving a difficult choice or a long wait
examples: For two [[agonizing]] minutes the plane dived, shook, and finally landed safely at the airport.

senses.en: extremely painful
examples: It was said that a few months ago Mr. Lin died after suffering years of [[agonizing]] pain.

senses.en: (also headlamp)

senses.zh: 呼出，吐出（肺中的空气、烟等）；呼气
senses.en: (fml.) breathe out the air or smoke, etc. in our lungs
examples: I changed my breathing pattern, inhaling and [[exhaling]] heavily after each set of exercise.

senses.zh: 水肺；自携式水下呼吸器

senses.en: help sb. to do sth.
examples: Families [[assisted]] teachers with the achievement of educational goals.

senses.en: come back up to the surface of the water
examples: When the [[divers]] did not [[resurface]] after an hour, three crew members dived down to look for them.

senses.en: appear again after being lost or missing
examples: She [[resurfaced]] briefly about eight years later, to compete with Noriko again for $5 million.

senses.en: (only before noun) relating to the heart
examples: It is generally believed that patients with [[cardiac]] problems should avoid foods that are high in salt.

senses.en: (only before noun) below the surface of an area of water, or able to be used there
examples: Each guide also includes full-color [[underwater]] photographs illustrating the marine life you could expect to see.

senses.en: if you look at sb. / sth. keenly or watch them keenly, you look closely at them and notice everything about them
examples: I looked at him [[keenly]]; he did not blink or even seem embarrassed by what he had just said.

senses.en: very strongly
examples: Scientists are [[keenly]] interested in learning which substances make fruits and vegetables so healthful.

senses.en: (fml.) cover or wrap sb. / sth. up completely
examples: The mist and rain [[enveloped]] the forest and we could only see the nearest trees.

senses.zh: 未开发的地区；荒野；荒凉之处
senses.en: a large area of land that has never been developed or farmed
examples: As we could see from the film, this place used to be a vast [[wilderness]] of mountains, lakes, and forests.

senses.zh: 未完全开拓的领域；新领域
senses.en: the limit of what is known about sth.
examples: The study of the brain is often described by scientists as the next intellectual [[frontier]].

senses.en: (esp. BrE) the border of a country
examples: Many of the cars crossing the [[frontier]] were stopped and searched for illegal goods.

senses.zh: （因违反法律、规则或合约而受到的）惩罚，处罚
senses.en: a punishment for breaking a law, rule, or legal agreement
examples: The contract includes heavy [[penalties]] for those people who fail to complete the work on time.

senses.en: (only before noun) relating to the sea and the creatures that live there
examples: We are all quite familiar with news items concerning [[marine]] pollution due to oil spills.

senses.en: a very small amount of sth.
examples: Employees' salaries are just a [[fraction]] of the total cost of the project.

senses.en: the act of traveling through a place in order to find out about it or look for sth. in it
examples: You can use this hut as a base for [[explorations]] into the mountains and forests around.

senses.en: an examination of sth. in order to find out about it
examples: This chapter begins with a detailed [[exploration]] of the issue of gender discrimination among all age groups.

senses.en: (esp. of people) strange and interesting because you do not know much about them
examples: I decided to find out more about my [[mysterious]] new neighbor who lived on the top floor.

senses.zh: 神秘的；奇怪的；不易理解的
senses.en: difficult to understand or explain; strange
examples: The police are investigating the [[mysterious]] disappearance of a new-born baby at the hospital.

senses.en: (~ of) a small number of people or things
examples: The new book is by a man who's already written a [[handful]] of best-sellers, most of them about space exploration.

senses.en: (~ of) the amount that you can hold in your hand
examples: The boy picked up a [[handful]] of stones and started throwing them at us, which made us annoyed.

senses.en: sb. / sth. that is dangerous
examples: Drivers like that are a [[menace]]. They shouldn't be allowed on the road.

senses.en: sometimes but not often
examples: We no longer keep up a close friendship, though we still visit each other on [[occasion]].

senses.zh: 按照···的条件；根据···的主张
senses.en: according to the conditions that sb. wants
examples: Don't just accept this job because it would make your parents happy — you need to act on your own [[terms]] for once.

senses.zh: 威廉 • 特鲁布里奇（新西兰自由潜水运动员）
